title: CoachingEvent v1
description: One rendered coaching hint. Mac and iOS must round-trip the same shape (for LAN companion later and for snapshot tests now). message is already-rendered narrative text; data is the flat {name} placeholder record from ADR 0028 so a client can re-render from the shared template registry.

ruleType.description: Rule family. harshness/gate/phase/gain are the ADR 0028 RuleType union; band-deviation is the live 7-band EQ-vs-ideal rule the phone runs first.

band.description: 7-band key from BAND_METADATA in packages/audio-engine/src/bands.ts, when the event is about one band.

data.description: Flat placeholder record (ADR 0028 RuleNarrativeData): string or number values only.

source.description: Where the measurement came from. phone-mic-estimate drives the "phone mic estimate" honesty cue in the UI.

sessionTime.description: Seconds since the live session started.
